description: Emitted-G-code witnesses for mixed-filament gradient sublayer Z, flow scaling, and per-volume region filtering.

mutants.description: Ignore the emitted sublayer flow multiplier. The positive-E ratio at each independently selected sub-Z must follow the configured gradient ratio.
Place every emitted sublayer at the nominal layer Z. The parser's independent fractional-Z witness must fail while the nominal component remains positive.
Skip construction of the per-volume region subset. The per-volume export must retain the short volume's absence in the upper tall-only layers and must emit positive flow for each selected volume.
